name: Everglades National Park
tagline: Anhinga / boardwalk wildlife — short wetland loop, not the whole 'Glades.

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; mosquito season is real — repellent helps.
practical.transit_note: Homestead / Florida City gateway to the main park road.
practical.energy_note: Heat, sun, bugs; boardwalks are the win for little kids.
practical.best_start: Ernest Coe or Royal Palm area → Anhinga boardwalk → visitor exhibits
practical.season_note: Dry season (winter) is easier for wildlife viewing and bugs.
